title: mertensia lanceolata var. secundorum
intro: Mertensia lanceolata var. secundorum, commonly known as Bluebells of the Woods or Western Bluebells, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Boraginaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds, coughs, and respiratory infections.
